status: FROZEN_AT_COMMIT (declared before any RUBBER-PHYS run; a change is rubber_phys_tests_v2, this file is never edited; SHA-256 pinned in tests/test_rubber_phys_config.py)
calibration_status: SIMULATOR_ONLY_UNCALIBRATED (numerical verification only; no real rubber data)

common.frame: strip-local: x along the length, free length x in [0, L] from the clamp face, y in [0, W], z in [0, t], gravity -z; clamp jaw x in [-2 dx, 0] (case A) has every component of every grid node with mass and reference x <= 0 prescribed
common.grid: dx = t / n_t, particle spacing s = dx / 2, particles at cell-centred lattice points, geometry on the lattice (L, W, t, jaw length multiples of s; minimum corner on a grid line)
common.young_effective: E_eff = 9 kappa mu / (3 kappa + mu), nu_eff = (3 kappa - 2 mu) / (2 (3 kappa + mu)), kappa = beta mu
common.tip: tip marker = centroid of the particles of the last lattice layer (reference x = L - s/2); deflection = reference z minus current z of that centroid
common.markers: K = 9 cross-section centroids at reference x_k = k L / 8 (k = 0..8), each the particles of the lattice layer nearest to x_k
common.step_rule: dt = control_dt / ceil(control_dt / (cfl dx / c_p)), c_p = sqrt((kappa + 4 mu / 3) / rho) of the test material
common.energy: E_total = KE_particle + Psi + E_grav - W_ext; Psi = sum_p V mu/2 (J^-2/3 I1 - 3) + sum_c V_c kappa/4 (Jbar^2 - 1 - 2 ln Jbar); E_grav = -sum m g.x relative to the start; grid KE reported alongside

static_initializer.label: initializer (never part of an episode; its result is the starting state, not a dynamic observable)
static_initializer.method: mass-proportional damping impulse -c m_p v_p dt at the solver CFL 0.5, c = 2 omega_1 with omega_1 = 2 pi f1_EB(E_eff) of the free length (critical for the first linear mode)
static_initializer.stop: checked every check_interval_s: max particle speed < min(1e-5 m/s, 1e-4 omega_1 delta_ref) AND |R_z + M g| / (M g) < 1e-3 (R = time-averaged clamp reaction over the interval, M = total mass)
static_initializer.max_time: 15 T1_EB (not converged = FAIL of that configuration)
static_initializer.alternative: kinetic damping (zero particle velocities at kinetic-energy peaks) is only admitted at CFL <= 0.25 (ADR 0023 E4 preserved failure) and is not used by v1 runs

RUBBER-PHYS-01.name: patch test: homogeneous F imposed by Dirichlet on every node

setup.imposed: one affine Dirichlet group holding every node with mass: target x = F X about the block centre (origin), F linearly interpolated from I over the single substep (float64 target evaluation)

RUBBER-PHYS-01.reference: section 5 PK1 in float64 evaluated on each particle's stored F with the float64 cell mean J-bar; objectivity P(RF) = R P(F)

criteria.jbar_consistency: |Jbar_c - J_p| <= 1e-6 for every particle p of every cell c
criteria.jbar_analytic: |Jbar_c - det F_target| <= 1e-5 for every cell (ADR section 6 patch tolerance)
criteria.interior_force: max over interior nodes ||f_I|| <= 1e-5 max over boundary nodes ||f_I|| (internal nodal force of the frozen P2G, gravity 0; interior = all 8 adjacent cells occupied)
criteria.objectivity: ||P(RF) - R P(F)||_F <= 1e-5 ||P(F)||_F for R in {90 deg about z, 37 deg about (1,2,3)/|.|} and every non-rotated case F (stress kernel, float32 storage)

RUBBER-PHYS-02.name: small-deflection cantilever sag (static, initializer)

setup.gravity_m_s2: per configuration such that the load parameter alpha = rho g A L^3 / (E_eff I) = 0.05 (linear regime: elastica / linear = 0.99997); the reference uses the same g

RUBBER-PHYS-02.reference: Euler-Bernoulli q L^4 / (8 E_eff I) for W <= 2t; plate bracket [EB (1 - nu_eff^2), EB] for W > 2t; two-grid extrapolation from n_t 3 and 4 with assumed order 2 (observed order needs three grids: P2-2)

criteria.wide_bracket: W = 4t: delta in [delta_EB (1 - nu_eff^2), delta_EB] (reported; ADR reference)
criteria.extrapolated: every configuration at n_t >= 3: |delta / delta_extrap - 1| <= 0.02 (delta_extrap of the same L/t, t, W)

RUBBER-PHYS-03.name: geometry scaling of the small-deflection sag

criteria.length_exponent: least-squares slope of log delta vs log L = 4 +- 0.15
criteria.thickness_exponent: least-squares slope of log delta vs log t = -2 +- 0.1

RUBBER-PHYS-04.name: free vibration of a clamped strip released straight under gravity

runs.substeps: 2 x those of the dt run

setup.batched: the dt run is repeated as env 0 of a heterogeneous CPU batch N = 4 (envs 1-3: L 0.048 m / W 0.012 m / mu 1.0e6 Pa and rho 1000; uniform dx and dt) and must equal the single run bitwise (L0); envs 1-3 must equal their own single runs bitwise

RUBBER-PHYS-04.reference: f_EB = (1.8751^2 / 2 pi) sqrt(E_eff I / (rho A L^4))

measurement.frequency: tip z minus its mean over the run; upward zero crossings (linear interpolation); f1 = (number of whole periods) / (last crossing - first crossing)
measurement.energy_drift: max_t |E_total(t) - E_total(0)| over the record samples
measurement.amplitude: half peak-to-peak tip z over the first whole period and over the last whole period (periods delimited by upward zero crossings)

criteria.batched_equal: batched N = 4 CPU records bitwise equal to the single runs

RUBBER-PHYS-05.name: large-deflection gravity sag vs the elastica

setup.geometry: L = alpha E_eff / (12 rho g (L/t)^2), t = W = L / 20

RUBBER-PHYS-05.reference: inextensible elastica BVP theta'' = alpha (1 - s) cos theta

criteria.jbar: every cell Jbar in [0.97, 1.03] at the static state

setup.grips: group 0: grid nodes with mass on the face x = 0, group 1: on the face x = L; component mask x on every face node, plus y and z on the face-centre node (y = W/2, z = t/2) and y on the node (y = W/2, z = 0) of each face (rigid modes pinned on symmetry lines); group 0 fixed, group 1 translates along x
setup.path: stretch lambda(t) = 1 + (lambda_max - 1)(1 - cos(pi t / T_r)) / 2 up to lambda_max = 2 over T_r, the mirror path back to 1 over T_r, then a hold of 10 T_ax at lambda = 1
setup.T_ax: 2 L / sqrt(E_eff / rho) (fixed-fixed axial period at small strain)
setup.T_r: 60 T_ax rounded up to a multiple of the control interval

measurement.nominal_stress: -R1_x / (W t), R1 = group-1 reaction averaged over a control interval, compared with the average of the analytic P11 over the interval's substep stretches; evaluated at the intervals whose mid-interval stretch is nearest to 1.25, 1.5, 2.0 (load) and 1.25, 1.5 (unload)
measurement.gauge_jbar: mean Jbar over the cells with reference centre x in [L/4, 3L/4] at the end of an interval vs J(lambda_end), all intervals
measurement.residual: time-averaged distance between markers k = 2 and k = 6 over the final hold vs its reference value

criteria.stress: relative error <= 0.01 at each evaluation point

RUBBER-PHYS-07.name: stretch and release

setup.path: cosine ramp to lambda 1.5 over 60 T_ax, hold 10 T_ax, then group 1 is removed (its nodes become free); afterwards 10 fixed-free axial periods (10 x 4 L / c0 = 20 T_ax)

RUBBER-PHYS-07.reference: elastic recovery; energy conservation after release (no external work: group 0 fixed, no gravity)

measurement.length: x(marker 8) - x(marker 0) time-averaged over the post-release window, relative to its reference value
measurement.energy: max over post-release control intervals of |E_total - E_total(release)| / E_total(release)

criteria.no_permanent_set: the elastic model has no internal variable; judged by the mean-length criterion

RUBBER-PHYS-08.name: homogeneous simple shear

setup.imposed: affine Dirichlet group on every node, gamma ramped linearly over 200 substeps (one control interval)

RUBBER-PHYS-08.reference: sigma_12 = mu gamma, sigma_11 - sigma_22 = mu gamma^2 (J = 1)
RUBBER-PHYS-08.measurement: mean Cauchy stress over all particles at the end

scenarios: cantilever_gravity (as -02 type, mu 2 MPa, g 9.81, from straight)
stretch_release (as -07 type, ramp to 1.5 over 2 control steps, release after step 3)

criteria.records: one record per control step for all 18 runs, every required field present with the declared shape, finite, header with surface particle ids and marker CSR

RUBBER-PHYS-10.name: single-env reference vs batched
RUBBER-PHYS-10.device: cpu (L0, L1) and cuda (L2 smoke, L3 band)

setup.L0: batched vs single bitwise on CPU for every array after every control step: N = 1, N = 3 heterogeneous (L, W, mu, rho, friction), N = 3 copies
setup.L1: perturbing env k leaves every other env bitwise unchanged; masked partial reset of one env equals a fresh env for every device array (vars()-complete), including resampled material parameters
setup.L2: GPU smoke N = 1, 4, 8: finite state, mass constant between resets, J domain, env-ownership audits, <= 1.5 GB at about 100k particles per env
setup.L3: GPU batched N = 4 per-env observables (tip marker z, Jbar min / max, elastic energy) at every control step inside [min, max] of 3 single-env GPU repeats, widened by max(1e-5 |value|, 1e-9)

criteria.L2: all invariants hold, VRAM peak <= 1.5 GB

criteria.gci: GCI <= 2 % for Q1-Q4 at rubber_rl_v1; CFL 0.5 -> 0.25 changes Q1-Q4 by <= 0.1 %

p2_1_scope.batched: RUBBER-PHYS-04 as a heterogeneous CPU batch (bitwise vs single) and RUBBER-PHYS-10 L0/L1 (CPU tests), L2/L3 on GPU when a GPU slot is available; batched runs of -02/-03/-05..-09 belong to R2.1 (P2-2)
p2_1_scope.verdict_rule: a test PASSes only if every configuration meets every criterion; a configuration that did not run is NOT_RUN, never PASS
